written_by: Claude Code, for Abyan Kashif to fill
notes: Opportunities for the Explore hub and the Opportunities feed (spec 22 → Data). Each row is in Stackd's own words, written from the official program page, which is its source_url. A post on Instagram or anywhere else is never the source and is never copied, quoted or embedded; the import refuses social media links. url is the page Open the official page opens, often the same as source_url. who_for lists what Stackd can't check (GPA, citizenship), shown as Check yourself. audience is community_college, admitted_transfer or any; major_slugs are Explore majors (data/raw/explore), empty for any major; systems is UC and/or CSU, empty for any; terms are transfer terms like fall-2027, empty for any. deadline is the last day to apply, or null for rolling. cost is free, paid (the student is paid, like a stipend) or fee (the student pays). Check each row on its source_url, fill in retrieved_at with the date you checked it, have a second person check it, then run: npm run import -- data/raw/opportunities/2026-27.json --dry-run First batch filled by Abyan on 2026-11-07: the two examples deleted and 20 real opportunities added, each checked on its official page that day. Rows with no published application deadline (TreeHacks, SF Hacks, CruzHacks, CodePath) have deadline null. Events use their own date as the deadline so they drop off once they're over. NASA internships: deadline 2027-02-26 and the June 7 to August 13 session are the team's call (Ryan and Abyan, 2026-11-08); nasa.gov showed a March 1, 2027 deadline and no session dates that day. Batch 2 added by Abyan on 2026-11-08: 22 more opportunities for the other majors (UC and Cal State transfer admission events, biology and health research, psychology and social science programs, and scholarships for any major), each checked on its official page that day. The NASA internships webinar row was removed at the team's request. Psi Beta's page gives its April 1 to June 1 window without a year, so the 2027 dates are read from it.

opportunities.title: Cooke Undergraduate Transfer Scholarship
opportunities.summary: A large, multi-year scholarship for top community college students starting a bachelor's degree in fall 2027. It can pay up to $55,000 a year toward what other aid doesn't cover, and comes with advising through graduation.
who_for: Sophomore standing at a community college by January 1, 2027, or graduated from one since spring 2022
Cumulative GPA of 3.5 or higher
Family adjusted gross income of $95,000 or less
Never enrolled at a four-year college
offers: Up to $55,000 a year toward finishing your bachelor's
Advising on the move to a four-year school
Chances to apply for internship and conference stipends

opportunities.title: Community College Internships (CCI), summer 2027
opportunities.org_name: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Science
opportunities.summary: A paid 10-week summer internship at one of 17 Department of Energy national labs, working on a technical project with a lab scientist or engineer. It's built for community college students.
who_for: U.S. citizen or permanent resident
18 or older when the internship starts
At least 12 college credit hours done, 6 of them in STEM, by the deadline
Cumulative GPA of 2.7 or higher (under 3.0 needs a short GPA statement)
wants: Transcripts
Recommendation letters
Short essays
offers: Travel paid if you live more than 50 miles from the lab
Housing help or an allowance, depending on the lab
opportunities.location: A Department of Energy national lab
opportunities.source_name: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Science

opportunities.title: National lab virtual internship fair
opportunities.org_name: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Science
opportunities.summary: An online fair, 1 to 5 p.m. Eastern, where you can meet people from Department of Energy national labs and ask about their paid 10-week summer 2027 internships.
wants: Register on the CCI page
opportunities.source_name: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Science

opportunities.title: CCI alumni panel
opportunities.org_name: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Science
opportunities.summary: An hour online, 2 to 3 p.m. Eastern, with past Community College Internships interns talking about their lab experience and how to put together a strong application.
wants: Register on the CCI page

opportunities.title: JPL Summer Internship Program
opportunities.summary: A full-time, 10-week summer internship at JPL, where you work on a project set by a JPL scientist or engineer and join tours, talks and career advising.
who_for: Enrolled in a STEM degree at an accredited U.S. school
Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher
U.S. citizen or permanent resident
Free to work 40 hours a week for at least 10 weeks in summer
wants: A resume
An unofficial transcript
offers: A monthly award for the length of the internship
Housing and travel allowance if your school is more than 50 miles from JPL

opportunities.title: NASA internships, summer 2027
opportunities.summary: Internships at NASA centers in science, engineering, technology and more. Most interns get a stipend based on their school level and how long the session runs.
who_for: U.S. citizen
GPA 3.0 or higher
18 or older by the start of the session
Enrolled full or part time in an accredited degree or certificate program

opportunities.title: NIH Summer Internship Program
opportunities.summary: Full-time summer research in an NIH lab, somewhere between May 10 and August 31, 2027, for community college, college and graduate students exploring research and health careers. It's in person only.
who_for: U.S. citizen or permanent resident
18 or older by September 30, 2027
Enrolled at least half time at a community college, college or university when you apply
wants: Reference letters, due February 2, 2027
offers: A stipend based on your school level
opportunities.location: Bethesda, Maryland, and other NIH campuses
opportunities.source_name: NIH Office of Intramural Training & Education

opportunities.title: Ernest F. Hollings Undergraduate Scholarship
opportunities.summary: Two years of tuition help plus a paid 10-week summer internship at a NOAA site, for students in ocean, atmospheric and environmental science and related fields, including math, engineering and computer science.
who_for: U.S. citizen
Must be applying to a 4-year school (community college students send proof)
Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher
A major that supports NOAA's work
offers: Up to $9,500 a year for two years
A paid summer internship at $700 a week
Travel to NOAA's orientation and science symposium

opportunities.title: Goldwater Scholarship
opportunities.org_name: Barry Goldwater Scholarship and Excellence in Education Foundation
opportunities.summary: A national scholarship for sophomores and juniors at two- or four-year schools who plan research careers in the natural sciences, math or engineering. You apply through your college's Goldwater campus representative.
who_for: Sophomore or junior at an accredited two- or four-year U.S. school
Needs a nomination from your college's Goldwater representative
Planning a research career in natural science, math or engineering
College GPA of 3.0 or higher
Meets the foundation's U.S. citizenship rules
Your college's own deadline comes weeks earlier
wants: A nomination from your college's campus representative
A research essay
Recommendation letters
offers: Up to $7,500 a year toward tuition, fees, books and housing
opportunities.source_name: Barry Goldwater Scholarship and Excellence in Education Foundation

opportunities.title: SMART Scholarship-for-Service
opportunities.summary: Full tuition, a yearly stipend and paid summer internships for STEM students. In return you work as a civilian at the Department of War after graduating, one year for each year of funding.
who_for: Citizen of the U.S., Australia, Canada, New Zealand or the U.K.
Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher
18 or older by January 1, 2028
Working toward a bachelor's or higher in a SMART field from fall 2027
Able to get a security clearance
offers: Summer internships at a Department of War site

opportunities.title: APIA Scholarship
opportunities.summary: Scholarships from $2,500 for one year up to $20,000 over several years for undergraduates, including community college students. APIA Scholars focuses on students living at or below the poverty line and the first in their family to go to college. The application opens November 15, 2026.
who_for: U.S. citizen, national or permanent resident (or of the Marshall Islands, Micronesia or Palau)
Enrolled or enrolling as an undergraduate for 2027-28

opportunities.title: Mathematical Contest in Modeling (MCM/ICM)
opportunities.summary: An international four-day contest where teams of up to three students choose a real-world problem, build a math model and write up their solution. Data, policy and sustainability problems are among the six choices.
who_for: Undergraduate (high school students can enter too)
Teammates enrolled at the same school
wants: A faculty advisor to register the team by 3 p.m. Eastern on January 28
A $100 registration fee per team
offers: Scholarship awards for the top six teams

opportunities.title: AMATYC Student Mathematics League, spring round
opportunities.org_name: American Mathematical Association of Two-Year Colleges
opportunities.summary: A one-hour, 20-question multiple-choice math contest for two-year college students, taken at your own college. Your score counts on its own, and your college's top five make its team.
who_for: Your college has to take part (ask your math department)
offers: A national ranking for you and your college
opportunities.source_name: American Mathematical Association of Two-Year Colleges

opportunities.title: TreeHacks 2027
opportunities.summary: Stanford's 36-hour student hackathon. Admitted hackers build a project over the weekend with workshops, prizes and recruiters on site. First-timers are welcome to apply.
who_for: Enrolled college student, undergraduate or graduate
wants: An application; admission is selective

opportunities.summary: San Francisco State's student-run hackathon: about 36 hours to form a team and build a project, with mentors and beginner workshops. Applications haven't opened yet.

opportunities.summary: UC Santa Cruz's student-run hackathon, with tracks on themes like sustainability and education, workshops for every level and a prize category for first-time hackers.

opportunities.title: Imagine Cup 2027
opportunities.summary: Microsoft's global startup competition. It's open to early-stage startups, with a Student Startup category for student founders. Teams of up to four build a product on Azure and compete for cash prizes and cloud credits.
who_for: 18 or older
A student founder, for the Student Startup category
wants: An application on Award Force
By February 28, a working product using at least 10 paid Azure services
offers: A Student Prize for the top student startup
Cash awards and Azure credits for top startups

Enrolled in, or on track for, an accredited college or trade program
